text.arabic_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ

words.gloss_range: ongoing directed asking, petition, and inquiry with the requested content unspoken and the divine object compactly attached
words.root_gloss_range: asking, questioning, petitioning, seeking, and desire-bearing request; local Form I active grammar selects creaturely asking directed to the divine object
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ}} ({{tr:yasʾaluhu}}) opens with the act of asking before the subject is named, so the reader first hears a posture of need and then watches its subject widen. The attached object pronoun sends that asking to one divine referent, while the unspoken request-content leaves the needs unenumerated. The imperfect active form keeps the asking ongoing and one-way from creation toward God; later same-root and cross-surah echoes sharpen the contrast, especially the passive non-questioning at 55:39 and time-question scenes such as 7:187, 75:6, and 51:12.

topics.headline: ongoing asking with compact divine object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word presents all need as ongoing petition directed to one divine object, not as a completed or content-specific question.
topics.reason: The local verb is imperfect active with an attached object suffix, and the bundle marks no explicit requested content after the verb.

topics.headline: verb first, cosmic subject delayed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah beginning with asking itself before the following subject expands the scene to a cosmic constituency.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the following relative phrase as the subject, so the opening verb creates a real VSO delay.

topics.headline: active creature-side asking, not fulfillment form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this form foregrounds creaturely requesting, while later and related forms help by contrast rather than changing the local voice.
topics.reason: The local form is active Form I; causative granting and passive same-root scenes are useful contrasts but do not govern the local parse.

topics.headline: asking answers the favor-boundary with need
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a same-surah and boundary movement: favor-denial gives way to petition, and present asking is later answered by non-questioning at 55:39.
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah and cross-surah references support an echo pattern without overriding the local verb semantics.

words.gloss_range: free relative subject meaning whoever, grammatically singular while opening a broad petitioner field
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) supplies the delayed subject of the opening verb as a free relative, not a question word. Its grammar is singular, but its reference expands through the following locative phrase, gathering the petitioner field without naming a narrower species. The scope can include rational petitioners directly and broader dependency by state, while local syntax keeps the word a declarative relative subject.

topics.headline: relative subject, not interrogative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word turns the clause into a declaration about whoever asks, not into a question.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the word as the subject of the verb and as a free relative whose scope is delimited by the following phrase.

topics.headline: singular grammar with broad petitioner scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one compact relative pronoun collecting a many-sided petitioner field while still controlling singular agreement.
topics.reason: The local grammar licenses singular agreement; broader all-dependent scope remains pressure from the cosmic phrase, not a replacement of the relative syntax.

topics.headline: from addressed pair to cosmic field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the register shift from direct challenge to the two addressees into a third-person panoramic fact of petition.
topics.reason: The prior refrain addresses a pair, while this word introduces a broad third-person relative subject.

words.gloss_range: locative-existential preposition defining the domain in which the petitioners are found
words.prose: The first {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) belongs inside the relative subject phrase: it defines where the askers are, not what they ask for. Its scope reaches across the coordinated upper and lower domains, turning them into one petitioner field. Because the same particle returns in the second clause with a stative force, this first occurrence also sets up the ayah's spatial-to-stative parallel.

topics.headline: preposition locates the petitioners
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition describes the subject domain, so the needs remain unlisted while the askers are located.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence places the prepositional phrase inside the relative subject span.

topics.headline: one preposition covers both domains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one preposition makes the heavens and earth a unified distributed field rather than two separate clauses.
topics.reason: The earth is coordinated under the same governed phrase, so the preposition scopes over both nouns.

topics.headline: spatial use prepares stative echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same preposition doing two jobs in the ayah: creaturely placement first, divine engagement later.
topics.reason: The two occurrences govern different complements and form parallel prepositional structures with different local functions.

words.gloss_range: the definite plural upper realms, governed by the preposition and paired with earth as the elevated side of the petitioner domain
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, upperness, sky or heaven, and related marking or naming discussions; local noun selects the elevated upper-realm branch
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) is the governed definite plural in the relative phrase, so the askers are located in the known upper realms rather than an unspecified sky. Its plural form keeps the upper domain layered, and its pairing with the singular earth makes the scope asymmetrical but total. Same-surah and corpus echoes matter because this familiar heavens-earth formula is specialized here: what usually marks cosmic totality becomes the residence of petitioners, with 55:33 later turning the same field into a boundary challenge.

topics.headline: known layered upper domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the heavens as a definite layered domain containing askers, not as an indefinite or singular sky label.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, plural, and genitive under the preposition.

topics.headline: elevation colors the upper realm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices vertical height and upperness in the noun's feel, while naming-derivation material remains only background pressure.
topics.reason: The local noun selects the sky or upper-realm sense; broader derivational disputes can color elevation but do not replace the local noun sense.

topics.headline: heavens-earth formula as petitioner field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a familiar cosmic-totality formula being given local agency: those within it ask.
topics.reason: The heavens-earth pair is locally coordinated under one preposition and has concrete parallels such as 55:33, 57:1, and 64:1.

topics.headline: upper first, lower second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the subject field descending from elevated plurality to grounded singularity before the ayah pivots to time.
topics.reason: The word order and plural-versus-singular contrast are both visible in the local phrase.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining earth to the heavens under the same prepositional scope
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is small but structural: it brings the earth into the same governed phrase as the heavens. The conjunction keeps the two domains distinct while making them one continuous petition-space, so the first clause does not restart after the upper realm. Its attached sound and writing fit the syntax: the lower domain is joined as continuation, not as an isolated afterthought.

topics.headline: earth coordinated under one preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction makes the earth part of the same locative scope, not a new clause.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence coordinates the earth with the heavens under the earlier preposition.

topics.headline: distinct domains become total scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices additive cosmic scope: heaven and earth remain two poles while together forming the total petitioner field.
topics.reason: The conjunction preserves the second noun as a coordinated domain while participating in the familiar cosmic pair.

topics.headline: visible and audible continuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the conjunction pulling the recitation and written phrase forward into the second domain.
topics.reason: The particle is proclitic to the following noun and performs the local coordination.

words.gloss_range: the definite singular earth, governed under the same preposition as the heavens and serving as the grounded lower pole of the petitioner field
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, ground, floor, base, and material foundation; local use selects the known terrestrial domain as a whole
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) closes the first clause's spatial field as the definite, singular ground-domain. It remains governed by the earlier preposition through coordination, so earth is not a loose second scene but the lower pole of the same petitioner span. The word's grounded root-image matters locally because it completes the high-low architecture: layered upper realms, then one known material base whose inhabitants also ask.

topics.headline: definite earth under same locative frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earth as the known lower domain inside the same asking field, not as a separate grammatical unit.
topics.reason: The noun is definite singular genitive and coordinated under the earlier preposition.

topics.headline: ground and foundation as lower pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth contributes grounded, material base imagery to the cosmic scope.
topics.reason: The local noun selects the earth or ground branch, paired with the upper-realm noun.

topics.headline: singular earth completes asymmetric totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the merism is not grammatically flat: plural heavens meet singular earth to complete the cosmic span.
topics.reason: The form contrast between plural upper domain and singular earth is explicit in the local phrase.

topics.headline: earth of provision becomes earth of petition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a same-surah movement from the earth placed for creatures at 55:10 to the earth whose inhabitants petition here, before the boundary challenge at 55:33.
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah references link the earth's provision role to its local inclusion in universal asking.

words.gloss_range: exhaustive eachness functioning as the accusative temporal-adverbial head of every day
words.root_gloss_range: whole, all, every, totality, and completeness; local construct distributes totality over repeated time-units
words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) turns the next noun into an exhaustive temporal frame: no day-like unit is outside the assertion. Its accusative adverbial role attaches the phrase to the divine-activity clause, so the ayah moves from the spatial scope of askers to the temporal scope of divine engagement. The construct keeps totality distributive, one time-unit at a time, rather than merely naming a fixed set of days.

topics.headline: every time-unit included
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exhaustive eachness over time: the claim is not occasional divine engagement but every day-like unit.
topics.reason: The word is an accusative quantifier-head in construct with the indefinite time noun.

topics.headline: temporal adverbial frames the second clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the temporal phrase frames the statement about divine engagement, not the earlier list of askers.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the phrase as the temporal adverbial for the nominal clause.

topics.headline: construct distributes totality one by one
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the construct does not mass time together; it iterates each day-like unit separately.
topics.reason: The quantifier and indefinite complement remain syntactically bound but visibly distinct.

topics.headline: from cosmic space to recurring time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this word as the hinge from where all beings ask to when divine activity is asserted.
topics.reason: Its position after the heavens-earth phrase and before the pronoun frames the transition into the second clause.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite bounded time-unit, genitive under every, open enough for recurring days or divinely relevant periods
words.root_gloss_range: day, time of day, event-time, and bounded period; local grammar keeps the unit indefinite and distributive under the quantifier
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمٍ}} ({{tr:yawmin}}) is the indefinite genitive unit over which the prior quantifier distributes. That form avoids naming one known eschatological Day and instead keeps each time-unit open, repeatable, and bounded. The word also ties the second clause to larger temporal contrasts: 55:39 moves to that day, 32:5 quantifies a cosmic day, and 80:37 uses the day-and-affair pair for human preoccupation, while here every time-unit corresponds to divine engagement.

topics.headline: open bounded day-like unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase does not point to one known Day; it opens every repeatable time-unit.
topics.reason: The noun is singular indefinite and genitive as the complement of the quantifier.

topics.headline: unit governed by every
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the time noun works through the construct phrase, not as an independent adverb floating by itself.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the noun as the genitive complement of the quantifier.

topics.headline: day and broader period without fixed scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word can hold ordinary days and broader bounded periods, while local grammar keeps the sense as repeated time-units rather than an unbounded abstraction.
topics.reason: The lexical range allows broader bounded periods, but the local construct with the quantifier selects distributive recurrence.

topics.headline: every day contrasted with that Day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the temporal word linking ongoing divine engagement to sharper contrasts at 55:39, 32:5, and 80:37.
topics.reason: The source rows give concrete references where the same temporal root participates in judgment, cosmic-management, and affair contexts.

words.gloss_range: independent third-person masculine pronoun beginning the nominal clause and isolating the divine subject of the affair
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) reappears as an independent subject after the divine referent had been compressed into the earlier object suffix. That shift changes the discourse role: the one asked becomes the one explicitly set before the predicate of ongoing affair. The pronoun also opens a nominal clause, so the second half reads as a stable assertion of engagement; the possible pronoun-of-affair pressure can enrich the clause, but the local referential reading remains primary.

topics.headline: explicit pronoun isolates the agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the divine referent standing independently before the predicate, not remaining hidden in a suffix.
topics.reason: The pronoun is an independent subject of the nominal clause and shares the discourse referent of the earlier suffix.

topics.headline: time phrase becomes full assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second clause shift from verbal motion into a stable nominal predication about divine engagement.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks a nominal clause with a prepositional predicate.

topics.headline: object suffix becomes subject pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same referent moving from recipient of universal asking to named agent of ongoing activity.
topics.reason: The discourse evidence links the object suffix and independent pronoun to the same divine referent.

topics.headline: pronoun-of-affair reading as secondary pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun can also make the following affair clause feel self-announcing, while the local referential subject remains grammatically secure.
topics.reason: The bundle allows the pronoun-of-affair reading, but cross-reference evidence strongly licenses the same divine referent as in the earlier suffix.

words.gloss_range: stative preposition forming the predicate phrase of the nominal clause and marking engaged involvement in an affair
words.prose: The second {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) is not spatial containment like the earlier occurrence. Here it governs the closing noun as the predicate of the pronoun, presenting the divine subject as engaged in an affair. Its repetition still matters: the ayah mirrors beings in a cosmic domain with God in a stative affair, using the same particle form while the governed nouns force different functions.

topics.headline: preposition of engaged state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition expresses engaged state or occupation, not physical location in a container.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the closing noun as the predicate phrase of the nominal clause.

topics.headline: immersion pressure inside abstract affair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices involvement from within the affair, while the local phrase remains a stative predicate rather than literal containment.
topics.reason: The concrete containment force can survive metaphorically, but the abstract governed noun and predicate role block a literal spatial reading.

topics.headline: same particle, changed function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural mirror: creatures are in the heavens and earth, while God is in an affair.
topics.reason: Both occurrences are the same particle form, but their governed complements and clause functions differ.

topics.headline: prepositional predicate completes clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verbless clause closing as a standing condition rather than a single narrated act.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is the predicate of the pronoun, with any copular element left unspoken.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite significant affair, state, or undertaking that closes the predicate and remains open under every-day recurrence
words.root_gloss_range: affair, matter, concern, event, rank, importance, state, and way of action; local use selects a weighty open-ended divine undertaking within the predicate phrase
words.prose: {{ar:شَأْنٍۢ}} ({{tr:shaʾnin}}) is the ayah's closing load-bearing noun: an indefinite affair, not a named or possessed one. Its root range gives the word weight as an eventful matter, state, or undertaking, so the predicate is more than generic busyness. Under the every-day frame, the singular indefinite makes each time-unit meet an open divine affair. The rare cross-surah uses sharpen the payoff: 10:61 has a human affair under divine witness, and 80:37 gives each person an absorbing affair on that Day, while 55:29 makes the divine subject Himself engaged every day. The final hamza also answers the opening hamza of the asking verb, audibly bracketing need and consequential engagement.

topics.headline: unspecified affair under every day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine engagement is left open and fresh, not reduced to one fixed named affair.
topics.reason: The noun is singular indefinite and unpossessed, governed by the stative preposition under the every-day frame.

topics.headline: significant eventful undertaking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing noun as a consequential affair or undertaking, not a bland label for activity.
topics.reason: The lexical range includes affair, event, condition, rank, and importance, and the local predicate selects a significant divine undertaking.

topics.headline: genitive object of stative predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun completes a standing prepositional predicate, broadening the answer beyond any single listed request.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the preposition in the predicate phrase of the nominal clause.

topics.headline: one affair per recurring time-unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recurring freshness in the singular indefinite affair, while the text does not require spelling out a new event inventory.
topics.reason: The every-day frame and indefinite singular support recurrence and openness; stronger claims of enumerated new creations are kept as cautious payoff rather than asserted beyond the local wording.

topics.headline: human affair contexts reversed into divine predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rare affair contexts in 10:61 and 80:37 sharpen 55:29 by contrast: human affairs or preoccupation become divine ongoing engagement here.
topics.reason: The source rows give concrete rare occurrences and phrase parallels, especially 10:61 and 80:37.

topics.headline: hamza and tanwin close the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah audibly framed from the hamzated asking at the start to the hamzated affair at the end, with the final indefinite cadence tying time to affair.
topics.reason: The sound rows connect the opening verb and closing noun through hamza, while the final tanwin echoes the time noun in the second clause.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active verb at word 1 takes Him as object, while 'whoever' spans the upper and lower domains and 'every day' attaches that asking to recurring affairs.
baseline_models.mechanism: Cosmic totality supplies requests and concrete needs; temporally renewed affairs supply the responsive side, so the line depicts universal dependence meeting continuous administration rather than an isolated prayer scene.

activation_trace.role: Asking and requesting supplies the creatures' outward act and makes dependence the mechanism's input.
Fulfillment supplies a latent response-pole within the root inventory; it does not make the active verb itself mean 'grant.'
The overhead covering domain supplies the upper extent of the asking population.
The lower ground opposite the sky completes the vertical totality.
Totality and completeness make the temporal claim exhaustive rather than occasional.
The bounded ordinary day supplies recurring temporal cadence.
Affair, state, or weighty matter supplies the changing object of administration.

changed_reading.before: All inhabitants ask Him, and He is occupied with something each day.
changed_reading.after: Every level of creation continually presents need to Him, while each recurring interval manifests a specific act of responsive administration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction 'every day ... in an affair' joins exhaustive recurrence to a noun whose inventory includes purpose and well-executed work.
baseline_models.mechanism: Day can widen from a solar day to any span or event-occasion, and affair can sharpen from generic business to aimed, fitting action; the line can therefore describe fresh purposive enactment at every temporal scale.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive totality distributes the claim across every relevant interval.
An open span of time prevents the mechanism from depending only on sunrise-to-sunset days.
An event-day or severe occasion lets each occurrence, not merely each date, become a temporal unit.
Aiming and seeking turns affair toward purpose rather than undirected activity.
Doing work well supplies fitness between each occasion and its enacted affair.

changed_reading.before: A different unspecified task occupies Him on each calendar day.
changed_reading.after: At every span and every event-occasion, He pursues and performs the affair fitting to it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A single object pronoun receives the asking of whoever occupies two opposed domains.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reciprocal-question branch activates a many-voiced network, but the grammar funnels every vector toward one addressee; plurality and convergence coexist without making the verb grammatically reciprocal here.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies the exploratory image of needs circulating through a populated network.
The upper covering domain supplies one pole of the network.
The lower opposite domain supplies the other pole.
Completeness gathers all separate voices into one convergent field.

changed_reading.before: Many unrelated individuals each make a private request.
changed_reading.after: A cosmos-wide network of voiced needs converges on one addressee, who remains the common center of every exchange.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence makes ongoing affairs formative: mercy discloses, measures into existence, and nurtures toward completion. Requests are thus not only answered with objects; creaturely capacities and conditions are continually formed.

activation_trace.role: The sought request supplies a concrete lack or desired outcome awaiting formation.
Well-executed work anchors the response as constructive action in the focus.
Mercy and tenderness supply the governing quality of the formative process.
Disclosure to a knower makes teaching an act that brings latent capacity into recognition.
Measuring and proportioning supply formation according to a fit rather than arbitrary production.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing turn repeated Lordship into developmental administration.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 orders mercy, teaching, creation, and articulation before the catalog of creaturely conditions.
The repeated dual-address refrain repeatedly returns those conditions to Lordship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, disclosure, measured creation, and nurture/completion; I infer an arrow from creaturely asking to continued formation, while a live alternative treats the sequence as adjacent signs rather than one causal program.

changed_reading.before: Daily affairs answer already-formed creatures' discrete requests.
changed_reading.after: His recurring affairs mercifully form, teach, repair, and complete the very creatures whose needs address Him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calculation, balance, equitable shares, and the prohibition of short measure turn responsive administration into calibrated apportionment. Universal asking does not entail arbitrary grant; each response can preserve a larger measure.

activation_trace.role: Totality makes the distributive mechanism answerable to the whole rather than one claimant alone.
Well-fitted action anchors calibrated response in the focus affair.
Counting and calculation supply an ordered cosmic cadence.
The balance of justice supplies the norm governing distribution.
Share and allotment make justice operational as apportioned portions.
Short measure supplies the failure mode that calibrated affairs prevent.

structural_cues: 55:5-9 moves from calculated celestial motion to a placed balance and then to human commands about measure.
The same balance term recurs across cosmic arrangement and social practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, weighing, just shares, and short measure; I infer a distributive arrow from daily affairs to proportioned response, while the live alternative confines balance to creaturely conduct rather than divine action.

changed_reading.before: Petitions are answered one by one as unconstrained favors.
changed_reading.after: Every affair apportions response within a measured whole, meeting needs without breaking the balance that holds all claimants together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two waters are released to meet yet held from transgression; valuable matter emerges and raised vessels run. This supplies a model in which an affair maintains a permeable boundary that enables exchange, production, and transit.

activation_trace.role: Affair or weighty matter anchors boundary-governance as one kind of focused administration.
The middle between two things supplies the interface where relation is governed.
Mixing and disturbance supply mobility at that interface.
Abundant broad water supplies the material reservoirs being related.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies actual contact rather than mere proximity.
Transgressive overreach supplies the boundary failure that is prevented.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the productive result of bounded meeting.
Running and flowing supply continued transit through the governed field.
Bringing something into being supplies deliberate construction within that transit system.

structural_cues: 55:19-24 orders release, meeting, non-transgression, emergence, and navigation.
Dual forms keep distinct parties present without collapsing their difference.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies meeting reservoirs, a non-transgressing interface, emergence, and running constructions; I infer that maintained difference enables production and transit, while a live alternative reads these as separate signs with no single mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Each affair is a standalone response to a standalone request.
changed_reading.after: Some affairs govern interfaces: they release domains into contact, restrain destructive crossing, and thereby let hidden value emerge and movement continue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, exhaustive creaturely perishing is set against enduring presence. 'Every day ... an affair' then reads as the active interface by which finite conditions are sustained, ended, and renewed under what remains.

activation_trace.role: Asking becomes the expression of ontological dependence, not only a verbal petition.
Open spans of time let renewal operate across more than ordinary days.
Exhaustive totality leaves no creature outside the condition of perishing.
Cessation after continuance supplies the finite endpoint of created states.
Continuance and remaining supply the stable side of the contrast.
Face standing for the self makes enduring presence personal rather than an abstract remainder.
Noble generosity colors the enduring source as giving, not merely surviving.

structural_cues: 55:26-29 places universal perishing, enduring presence, the refrain, and universal asking in immediate sequence.
The root ج ل ل at 55:27 has no branch inventory and is used only as an uncited structural intensifier of the enduring side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive perishing beside enduring, generous presence; I infer that recurring affairs mediate the sustaining and replacement of finite states, while the live alternative is a mortality-eternity contrast with no renewal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Existing beings ask for episodic help while God performs unrelated daily tasks.
changed_reading.after: Perishing beings depend at every span on the enduring source whose affairs continually sustain, terminate, and renew their changing conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-future declaration of turning to the two weighty communities exposes and repairs a misleading 'busy workload' reading. Vacancy after work is a live branch, but directed intention permits decisive attention without implying that prior affairs exhausted capacity.

activation_trace.role: Every open span supplies ceaseless temporal coverage and creates the apparent workload problem.
Affair supplies engagement but does not by itself entail distraction or finite capacity.
Vacancy after occupation surfaces the finite-workload reading that the sequence puts under pressure.
Directed intention supplies a noncompetitive turn toward a matter without requiring prior inactivity.
Weighty preciousness makes the two addressed communities a concentrated object of attention.

structural_cues: 55:31 follows the focus after one refrain and shifts to a future first-person address.
The dual 'two weighty ones' concentrates the universal population into two accountable communities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both vacancy and directed-intention branches plus the future dual address; I use intention to correct the finite-busyness implication, while the live alternative hears literal leisure after one phase of occupation.

changed_reading.before: He is busy with one task after another and will later become free for another audience.
changed_reading.after: No recurring affair crowds out another; ceaseless engagement coexists with a decisive, future-directed turn toward the two weighty communities.

context_deltas.mechanism: Passage through the cosmic perimeter depends on effective authority, and what is dispatched enforces the limit. The focus affair therefore includes executable permission and prohibition, not merely attention to a topic.

activation_trace.role: Work done effectively anchors enactment in the focus's affair.
Clean passage to the other side supplies the attempted boundary crossing.
Execution and making an order effective turn passage into an administrative analogue.
Power and delegated authority supply the condition under which crossing can become effective.
Dispatch and emission supply enforcement moving outward from the authoritative center.

structural_cues: 55:33 challenges both communities to cross the limits of the heavens and earth, the same paired domains named in the focus.
55:35 answers attempted passage with something sent upon them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passage, execution, authority, and dispatch; I infer that some daily affairs issue effective permissions and prohibitions, while the live alternative confines this mechanism to the final-scene warning.

changed_reading.before: An affair is a matter occupying divine attention.
changed_reading.after: An affair can be an executable decree that authorizes passage, maintains a perimeter, or dispatches enforcement across the two domains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus has all creatures asking Him; later, no human or jinn is asked about guilt, because offenders are recognized by marks and seized. Asking is directionally asymmetric: need petitions upward, while judgment does not require information-gathering interrogation.

activation_trace.role: Active asking/requesting supplies the creature-to-God direction in the focus.
Negated passive questioning reverses both direction and forensic function.
Sin and guilt supply the information that an interrogation would ordinarily seek.
Recognition after a sign supplies a nonverbal route to disclosed state.
A visible identifying mark supplies the evidence that makes fact-finding questions unnecessary.
Being taken to account for guilt converts recognized state directly into consequence.

structural_cues: 55:39 uses a negated passive of the same asking root used actively in 55:29.
55:41 follows with recognition by marks and immediate seizure, supplying a functional replacement for interrogation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated questioning, guilt, recognition by marks, and seizure; I infer that disclosed signs remove any need for fact-finding, while the live alternative treats 55:39 and 55:41 as separate judgment details.

changed_reading.before: Asking is a general two-way relation between ruler and subjects.
changed_reading.after: Creatures ask because they lack; He does not ask from lack of knowledge, and judgment can pass from manifest sign directly to consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Running springs, gushing abundance, like-for-like good return, and stable growing good give responsive affairs a mature form: provision flows, becomes available, and persists as recompense rather than appearing as an isolated grant.

activation_trace.role: Fulfillment supplies the latent response-pole connecting requests to realized provision.
Well-done action anchors provision as an enacted affair rather than a static possession.
Ongoing sustenance and giving turn the running springs into a durable supply pattern.
A source of flowing water supplies provision at its point of emergence.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies responsive proportionality.
Doing good supplies both the initiating act and the quality returned.
Water welling abundantly intensifies response from flow to surplus.
Stable, growing good supplies persistence beyond the moment of grant.

structural_cues: The garden sequence repeatedly alternates descriptions of available goods with the refrain of recognition or denial.
55:60 places reciprocal good between the two garden tiers, linking action and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies running sources, proportionate return, abundant outflow, and stable growing good; I infer that response matures into sustained recompense, while the live alternative confines all these images to a future reward scene.

changed_reading.before: An affair grants a requested item and then passes.
changed_reading.after: Responsive affairs can open sources, sustain flow, return good for good, and stabilize the result as growing provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This depends on the non-dominant س ل ل mapping of the focus asking root and is therefore form-distant; it remains anchored at word 1 and gains mechanism from emergence and water-flow cues. Render only as an extraction analogy, never as a lexical replacement for ordinary asking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory for the focus verb includes gentle hidden drawing-out alongside ordinary asking.

activation_trace.role: Gentle hidden extraction supplies the surprising claim that asking can draw latent response outward.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each request acts like a channel that draws a latent provision from concealment into sustained manifestation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The anatomical branch of ش ء ن is remote from ordinary 'affair,' so this is a material analogy rather than a semantic claim. It remains anchored in the focus noun and is reinforced by the surah's eye, tear-channel, source, and flow images; downstream prose should label it explicitly exploratory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun at word 10 has an inventory branch of skull junctions and tear channels.

activation_trace.role: Junctions and tear channels supply a distributed conduit model for recurring affairs.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, recurring affairs are junctions in a distributed channel system through which response reaches different parts of creation.

It remains valid as a cross-root activation because later judgment explicitly joins recognition to visible marks; render as a secondary legibility model.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory beneath the focus's heavens word includes visible marks and signs readable by observation, while the focus affair supplies what may inscribe changing state.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark turns the upper domain into an exploratory field of legible traces.
A sign read by discerning observation supplies the act of interpreting those traces.
Changing affair anchors the proposed inscription of state in the focus.
Recognition after an effect or sign supplies successful reading of state.
An explicit identifying mark confirms that visible state can replace verbal disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Daily affairs happen within an otherwise passive cosmic container.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each affair leaves the heavens-and-earth field newly legible, inscribing states that can later be recognized without questioning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the non-dominant س م م mapping under the focus heavens root and is strongly form-distant. It remains spatially anchored by the named heavens and by later passage, perimeter, and splitting constructions; render only as an aperture-and-boundary analogy, not as the lexical sense of the focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split focus inventory offers a narrow opening of entry under the heavens root, while the line places all inhabitants inside cosmic domains under recurring affairs.

activation_trace.role: A narrow aperture supplies controlled entry through an otherwise enclosing upper domain.
Affair anchors aperture control as an administrative matter rather than free-standing cosmology.
An unblocked passage supplies the route that controlled apertures would permit or deny.
Sides and perimeter supply the bounded surface through which passage is attempted.
Splitting open supplies the terminal transformation of the enclosing surface.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are only a location containing some petitioners.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the heavens are a layered enclosure whose admissible passages are opened, blocked, or finally split as part of recurring governance.

strongest_changes: The 55:26-31 sequence changes ceaseless affairs from finite busyness into enduring, noncompetitive attention toward perishing dependents.
Calculation, balance, bounded waters, and executable authority recast affairs as calibrated boundary-governance that both enables emergence and enforces limits.
55:39-41 reverses asking: creatures petition from need, but judgment needs no fact-finding question because marks disclose state.
Flowing sources and reciprocal good preserve a provisioning reading alongside the adjudicative reading rather than forcing one final sense.
summary.what_was_special: Split mappings kept four easy-to-lose activations alive: asking as gentle extraction, affairs as channels, the cosmos as a marked field, and heavens as an apertured enclosure. They coexist with the stronger mercy, measure, finitude, authority, and judgment models under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet juxtaposes mechanisms but does not itself prove every causal arrow from asking to formation, measure, renewal, or reward.
The relation between ceaseless affairs and the future turn at 55:31 may be noncompetitive intention or a genuine phase transition.
Every day may denote ordinary days, open spans, event-occasions, or several of these at once.
The س ل ل, و س م, س م م, and anatomical ش ء ن activations remain deliberately form-distant analogies.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Universal dependence as ongoing request.** `س ء ل/B001` (asking or seeking) is distributed over inhabitants of heavens and earth, while `ك ل ل` and “every day” extend scope and recurrence. I infer that creaturely need is continuous rather than episodic. The ayah reads as a daily dependence mechanism joining both realms.
2. **Order sustained by responsive action.** `ش ء ن/B001` assigns a concrete affair or matter to each day. Celestial reckoning (55:5) supplies regularity; asking supplies variable demand. I infer that stable order is maintained through ongoing responses to changing needs. The ayah reads against a closed, self-running cosmos.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:31 turns from creatures addressing Him to a future concentrated address toward the two communities. The direction of attention reverses: those who continually ask become those to whom decisive attention is directed.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **`س ء ل` `B001` / `B002` — “ask” / “request,” `ك ل ل` `B003` — “totality,” `ي و م` `B002` — “a span,” and `ش ء ن` `B001` — “affair.”** Structural cue: an unrestricted relative subject spans heavens and earth, then `كُلَّ` distributes divine affair across every temporal span. Assigned role: universal request states continuing need; recurring affair states continuing administration. Packet evidence is the two universal constructions and accepted branches. Inference: enduring lordship is dynamically expressed by responding within changing conditions, which also grounds the focused reckoning announced in 55:31. Reading change: the ayah reconciles permanence with ceaseless action rather than opposing them.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:31 reclassified continuous affair rather than contradicting it: general administration narrows rhetorically into concentrated attention toward the two weighty kinds.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 Paired Limits and Controlled Passage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Paired fields meet or move within assigned limits, and productive passage occurs without dissolving those limits.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same geometry governs horizon, water interface, extraction, and navigation; a boundary can prevent destructive trespass while still permitting emergence and transit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Paired Horizons as Endpoints
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Light rises from one directional limit and withdraws at another, establishing opposed but coordinated horizons.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sunrise and eastern direction `quranic:root_000790:B001/m01`; sunset and western direction `quranic:root_001077:B006/m01`; distance and removal from home `quranic:root_001077:B007/m01`; sheltering sky `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; ground opposite the sky `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; ownership and command `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; gradual ordering and care `quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: East and west are not isolated places but terminal relations within one managed field. Rising, setting, distance, and return make the horizon pair a temporal-spatial instrument whose limits remain under a single owner.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 Enduring Authority and Continuous Provision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Contingent beings pass and repeatedly need, while a distinguished authority remains and continually answers changing affairs.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Remaining is not inert duration; lexical pardon, reserve, encompassing cover, and daily administration turn persistence into active preservation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Petition and Daily Administration
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Dependents present needs to an owner who attends to, repairs, and carries out a changing succession of affairs.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: asking and requesting `quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`; desired need `quranic:root_000661:B002/m01`; satisfying a request `quranic:root_000661:B003/m01`; reciprocal questioning `quranic:root_000661:B004/m01`; affair or weighty circumstance `quranic:root_000773:B001/m01`; aim and sought object `quranic:root_000773:B002/m01`; competent execution `quranic:root_000773:B003/m01`; disruption of an affair `quranic:root_000773:B004/m01`; bounded day `quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`; duration `quranic:root_001700:B002/m01`; critical event `quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`; sovereign ownership `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; gradual repair and nurture `quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Asking supplies participants and needs; *shaʾn* supplies the mutable work; and the day supplies recurring time. Lordship joins ownership to incremental repair, so the scene is one of continuous administration in which changing requests are met without exhausting the remaining source.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiden bilgi edinmek için ona yönelmeyi ve bir şeyi ondan istemeyi aynı dalda açıkça tanımlar. Doğrudan nesne alan kullanım istek bildirmeye, bir konu ya da kişiyle kurulan ilgeçli kullanımlar ise bilgi edinmeye yönelir; çok soran kişi ve yardım isteyen yoksul için kullanılan adlar bu eylem çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sorma ve isteme eylemlerini kapsar; istenen şeyin kendisini, isteğin karşılanmasını ve karşılıklı sormayı ayrı dallara bırakır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın eylem çekirdeğini korurken, doğrudan bir şeyi isteme ile bir konu veya kişi hakkında bilgi sorma kalıplarını ayrı uygulamalar olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yönelerek ondan bir şey isteme ya da bir konu, nesne veya kişi hakkında bilgi edinmeye çalışma eylemidir. Doğrudan nesneli istek ve ilgeçli bilgi sorusu bu çekirdeğin farklı kuruluşlarıdır; çok soran veya yardım isteyen kişiye verilen adlar eylemden türeyen kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir muhataba yönelip bilgi edinmeye veya bir şeyi elde etmeye çalışma eylemini bildirir.
Bir şeyi doğrudan muhataptan isteme ile bir konu ya da kişi hakkında bilgi sorma, eylemin farklı söz dizimsel kuruluşlarıdır.
Çok soru soran kimse ve gereksinimini bildirerek yardım isteyen yoksul, eylemi yapan kişi olarak adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sorma ve isteme eylemlerini birlikte verir; doğrudan nesneli kullanımda bir şey istenirken, bir konu veya kişi hakkında kurulan kullanımda bilgi aranır. Eylem adı, çok soran kimse ve yardım isteyen kişi de aynı tanıklık kümesinde yer alır.

concept_gloss.text: bilgi sormak veya bir şey istemek
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın bir muhataptan bilgi ya da istenen bir şeyi elde etmeye yönelen eylem çekirdeğinin tamamı için uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı, bir insanın gerçekten istediği şey olarak tanımlar ve onu yalnızca zihinde tasarlanan bir dilekten ayırır. Bu nedenle dalın kimliği isteme eylemi değil, isteğin yöneldiği nesne veya karşılanması beklenen içeriktir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, kişi tarafından istenmiş olan şeyle sınırlıdır; henüz istek olarak ortaya konmamış dilek ve isteme eyleminin kendisi kapsam dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, herhangi bir özel kalıba bağlı olmadan, kişi tarafından istenen şeyi yalın dal anlamı olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın istediği, kendisine verilmesini ya da gerçekleşmesini talep ettiği şeydir. Bir dileğe yakın olabilir, ancak burada belirleyici olan onun gerçekten istenmiş olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin isteme eylemine konu ettiği şeyi veya karşılanmasını istediği içeriği belirtir.
Dileğe yaklaşır, fakat yalnızca tasarlanan olasılığı değil, kişi tarafından istek olarak ortaya konmuş şeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kavramı insanın istediği şey olarak tanımlar. Dilekle ortak bir arzu alanı bulunsa da, bu dalın ayırıcı sınırı söz konusu şeyin kişi tarafından gerçekten istenmiş olmasıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin açıkça istediği nesne, sonuç veya karşılanacak içerik için dalın tamamını doğal ve kısa biçimde karşılar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sahiplik ekiyle bir kişinin elde etmek ya da gerçekleşmesini görmek istediği şey anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye bağlı, gerçekleşmesi veya verilmesi istenen içeriği doğal biçimde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dilekle yakınlığın yanında, dileğin açık bir isteğe dönüşmüş olduğu özellikle belirtilmek istendiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dileğe yakınlığı ve bunun yalnızca tasarı olarak kalmayıp istek konusu olmasını birlikte korur.
Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesine yönelik arzu ve beklenti yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Henüz bir kimseden istenmemiş, yalnızca zihinde tasarlanmış arzuları da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şeyin bir kişi tarafından gerçekten istek konusu yapılmış olmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İçten duyulan gereksinim ve yoğun arzu yönünü, açık bir istekten bağımsız olarak öne çıkarabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal için belirleyici sınır, içeriğin kişi tarafından istenmiş olmasıdır. Komşu dal ise kişinin içinde duyduğu gereksinim ve dilek yönünü daha güçlü taşır; bu yüzden her bağlamda açıkça yöneltilmiş bir istek gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin istek konusu yapılmış nesne veya içerik olmasını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesini arzulama eylemini, bunun istenmiş bir nesneye dönüşmesini gerektirmeden belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da henüz elde bulunmayan bir şeyin gerçekleşmesine yönelen arzu vardır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Eksiklik, zorunluluk ve kimi kullanımlarda güçlü bir giderilme baskısı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişinin elde etmeyi veya gidermeyi istediği içerik iki dalda da bulunabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir muhataba yöneltilen sorma ya da isteme eylemini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de aynı istek olayının farklı parçalarını kavramlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal isteğin içeriğidir; komşu dal ise kişinin o içeriği elde etmek için gerçekleştirdiği eylemdir. Aynı olayda birlikte bulunmaları anlam bakımından özdeş oldukları anlamına gelmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir türemiş kuruluşu, başka bir kişinin isteğini veya gereksinimini karşılamak anlamında açıkça tanımlar. Dal, istekte bulunma eylemini ya da istenen şeyi değil, isteğe cevap veren kişinin gerçekleştirdiği karşılama sonucunu merkez alır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca tanıklanan türemiş kuruluşta geçerlidir ve bir başkasının isteğini karşılama eylemiyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kökün genel anlamına yayılmaz; yalnızca tanıklanan türemiş ifadede bir başkasının isteğini veya gereksinimini karşılama anlamını verir.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin isteğini yerine getirerek onun gereksinimini karşılamayı bildirir.
Karşılama anlamı, genel sorma eylemine değil, kaynakta tanıklanan türemiş ifadeye özgüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, türemiş ifadeyi bir başkasının isteğini veya gereksinimini karşılama şeklinde açıklar. Bu, talepte bulunanın eyleminden ayrı olarak, talebe cevap veren kişinin gerçekleştirdiği sonuçlu eylemdir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tanıklanan türemiş kuruluşta, başka bir kişinin istediği şeyi yapma veya gereksinimini karşılama anlamının tamamı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başka bir kişinin isteğine cevap vermeyi ve istenen sonucu gerçekleştirmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İstenen şeyin belirli bir nesneden çok kişinin giderilecek gereksinimi olarak sunulduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir başkasındaki eksikliği gidermeyi ve onun beklediği sonucu sağlamayı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İsteği, yalnızca bir nesne vermekle sınırlı olmadan yerine getirmeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İsteyene istediği şeyi verme veya onu istenen nesneyle donatma yönünü özellikle belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: isteğini yerine getirmek ile istediğini vermek
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir istekte bulunana olumlu cevap verilip istediği sonuç sağlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal isteğin veya gereksinimin karşılanmasını genel sonuç olarak anlatır. Komşu dal ise bunu özellikle istenen şeyi verme ya da sağlayarak yardım etme biçiminde gerçekleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kişinin başka birinin isteğine karşılık veren eylemini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin yeterli gelmesi ve kişiyi başka bir şeye gereksinim duymaktan kurtarması durumunu belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir gereksinimin giderilmesi ve eksikliğin sona ermesi sonucu bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda bir kişi diğerinin isteğini yerine getirir; komşu dalda ise bir şeyin yeterliliği merkezdedir ve mutlaka istek üzerine davranan bir sağlayıcı bulunmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İsteğin bir eylem yapılarak veya gereksinim giderilerek karşılanmasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sorana belirli bir şeyi verme eylemiyle sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir kişinin istemesine karşılık ona olumlu bir sonuç sağlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, istek ya da gereksinimin farklı yollarla yerine getirilmesini kapsar. Komşu dalın çekirdeği ise soran kişiye somut olarak bir şey vermektir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İsteğe cevap veren kişinin gereksinimi gideren eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İsteyen kişinin muhataba yönelttiği sorma veya isteme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı istek olayında biri talepte bulunurken diğeri bu talebe cevap verebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Dallar aynı olayın farklı katılımcı evrelerini gösterir: komşu dal isteğin yöneltilmesidir, odak dal ise istenen sonucun sağlanmasıdır. Biri gerçekleşmeden ötekinin anlamı varsayılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; isteği karşılama çekirdeğini verme, yeterli gelme ve istekte bulunma eylemlerinden ayıran dört ilişki yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أسألته سؤلته ومسألته بمعنى قضيت حاجته.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه طلب السائل نفسه ولا مجرد تسمية المطلوب سؤلا.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أسألته سؤلته ومسألته أي قضيت حاجته (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir topluluğun üyelerinin birbirlerine soru yöneltmesini açıkça bildirir. Karşılıklılık yalnızca aynı ortamda birden çok soru bulunması değildir; katılımcıların soran ve kendisine sorulan rollerini birbirlerine göre üstlenmesi dalın kurucu özelliğidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılıklı soru yöneltmeyi gerektirir; tek kişinin başkasına yönelttiği ve karşı taraftan soru gelmeyen kullanım genel sorma dalında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tanıklanan biçimin yalın dal anlamını karşılıklı soru yöneltme olarak verir ve başka konuşma alışverişlerini bu anlama katmaz.

concept_map.definition: İki veya daha çok kişinin birbirlerine soru yöneltmesi, böylece her birinin ötekine göre soran ve kendisine sorulan konumlarına girmesidir. Yalnızca tek yönlü bir soru bu karşılıklılık koşulunu karşılamaz.

facets.statement: Birden çok katılımcının birbirlerine soru yöneltmesini ve soru rollerini karşılıklı üstlenmesini bildirir.
Eylem, yalnızca aynı ortamda soru sorulmasını değil, soruların katılımcılar arasında karşılıklı yönelmesini gerektirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, biçimi kişilerin birbirlerine soru sorması olarak açıklar. Bu açıklama, genel soru eylemine karşılıklı katılım ve rollerin katılımcılar arasında değişmesi koşulunu ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: İki veya daha çok katılımcının soruları karşılıklı olarak birbirlerine yönelttiği dal çekirdeğinin tamamı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Soru eylemini, katılımcı çokluğunu ve soruların karşılıklı yönelmesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Katılımcıların birbirlerinden bilgi almak amacıyla sırayla veya karşılıklı soru yönelttiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı soru yöneltmeyi ve bu yolla bilgi edinme amacını bağlam içinde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Katılımcıların birbirlerine soru yöneltmesini ve rollerin karşılıklı olmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tek yönlü soru veya istek için karşı taraftan benzer bir yöneliş gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın merkezinde bir muhataba soru yöneltme eylemi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel sormaya karşılıklılık koşulu ekler: katılımcılar birbirlerine soru yöneltir. Komşu dalda tek bir soranın tek yönlü eylemi anlamın kurulması için yeterlidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karşılıklı eylemin birimleri özellikle sorulardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Katılımcıların bir konu üzerinde birlikte ilerlemesi, konuşması veya görüş alışverişi yapması soru bulunmadan da gerçekleşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birden çok konuşanın aynı konuda karşılıklı iletişim kurmasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda tarafların birbirlerine soru yöneltmesi zorunludur. Komşu dal karşılıklı konuşma ve bir konuyu birlikte ele alma sürecidir; soru-cevap yapısı onun kurucu koşulu değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her katılımcının ötekine soru yöneltmesini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Söze, soruya veya çağrıya cevap vermeyi ve konuşmanın geri dönüşünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de konuşanlar arasında gidip gelen söz ve bilgi alışverişi içinde gerçekleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kurucu eylemi sorudur ve karşılıklılık soruların yönünde bulunur. Komşu dal ise verilen cevabı, sözün geri çevrilmesini ve daha geniş diyalog sürecini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Söz sırasından bağımsız olarak katılımcıların birbirlerine soru yöneltmesini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir konuşanın susup ötekinin konuşmasına dayalı sıra değişimini anlatır; söylenenlerin soru olması gerekmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birden çok kişinin söz alıp birbirine yöneldiği konuşma alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal soru türünü ve karşılıklı yönelmeyi tanımlar; komşu dal konuşma sırasının el değiştirmesini tanımlar. Karşılıklı sorular eşzamanlı bir alışverişte bulunabilir, sırayla konuşma ise sorusuz da olabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; karşılıklı soru koşulunu genel sorma, görüşme, cevaplaşma ve sırayla konuşmadan ayıran dört komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تساءلوا أي سأل بعضهم بعضا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه سؤال الواحد لغيره من غير مقابلة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden nazikçe ve belli etmeden çekip çıkarma eylemini doğrudan verir. Kılıcı kınından çekme ile hamurdan kıl ayıklama bu çekirdek işlemin özel uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, izinli ya da izinsiz almaya değil, ayırıp çıkarma biçimine odaklanır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel çekip çıkarma eylemini kapsar; kılıç ve hamur kalıplarını bu genel anlamın özel uygulamaları olarak ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeyin içinden ya da üzerinden nazikçe ve fark ettirmeden çekerek ayırıp çıkarmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi bağlı veya kapalı bulunduğu yerden çekerek ayırıp çıkarma işlemi vardır.
Kılıcın kınından çekilmesi ve hamurdaki kılın ayıklanması bu işlemin somut örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bir şeyi başka bir şeyden çekerek çıkarmadır; anlatım bu işlemin incelikli ve gizli yapılabildiğini de korur.

concept_gloss.text: nazikçe ve fark ettirmeden çekip çıkarma
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin bulunduğu yerden incelikle ayrılıp çıkarıldığı dalın tamamı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çekme, ayırma, çıkarma, incelik ve gizlilik özelliklerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesnenin bir yerden incelikle çıkarıldığı genel eylem bağlamlarında doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Çekerek çıkarma işlemini ve incelikli yapılış biçimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Eylemin fark ettirmeden yapılması koşulunu tek başına açıkça belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hamurdan kıl gibi istenmeyen bir parçanın ayrıldığı somut ayıklama bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir parçayı bulunduğu maddeden ayırıp çıkarma işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kılıç gibi kapalı bir yerden çekilen nesneleri ve gizlilik özelliğini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her tür nesnenin bulunduğu maddeden ya da kaptan incelikle çıkarılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnızca kılıcın kınından çekilmesini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir nesne, içinde bulunduğu kapalı yerden çekilerek çıkarılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal kılıç ve kın ilişkisine özgüdür; odak dal ise aynı çıkarma düzenini hamurdaki kıl gibi başka nesnelere de uygular.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; en keskin sınırı, genel çekip çıkarma ile kılıca özgü çıkarma arasındaki ayrım verdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نزع الشيء من غيره وإخراجه برفق وخفاء كسل السيف من الغمد وسل الشعر من العجين
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس السرقة ولا الولد ولا المرض ولا السلسلة ولا الماء السلس

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça gizli hırsızlık ve evden hırsızlık amacıyla alma olarak tanımlar. Rüşvet yalnızca bir biçimin ek kullanımında geçer ve dalın hırsızlık çekirdeğini değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sıradan çekip çıkarmadan suç amacı ve gizlilik koşuluyla ayrılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım türemiş biçimlerdeki gizli hırsızlık alanına bağlıdır; bu alan yalın çekip çıkarma anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi, özellikle bir evden, gizlice ve hırsızlık amacıyla almaktır.

facets.statement: Alma eylemi gizli yapılır ve hırsızlık niteliği taşır.
Bir kaynak birleşiminde aynı biçim hırsızlığın yanında rüşvetle de ilişkilendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım gizli hırsızlığı merkeze alır; birleşik kaynak ifadesi, bir biçim için rüşvetle bağlantılı daha geniş bir kullanımı da bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gizlilik ve hırsızlık amacı taşıyan alma eyleminin çekirdek karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem gizli yapılışı hem de izinsiz alma ve hırsızlık niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin evden hırsızlık yoluyla alındığı açık bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gizli alma eylemini ve hırsızlık amacını eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Ev dışındaki gizli hırsızlık bağlamlarını kapsam dışında bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kullanımın birlikte bildirildiği özel biçimi açıklamak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gizli hırsızlık çekirdeğini ve bildirilen yan kullanımı birlikte gösterir.
error_profile.adds: Dalın genel çekirdeğinde zorunlu olmayan rüşvet kullanımını ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hırsızlığı gizlilik ve fark ettirmeden alma yönüyle sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Almayı hız, kapıp kaçma ve kimi zaman zor kullanma yönüyle tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da başkasına ait bir şeyi izinsiz alma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı koşulu gizliliktir; komşu dalda belirleyici özellik hızlı kapma veya zorlayıcı biçimde el koymadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; gizli hırsızlık ile hızlı kapıp alma karşıtlığı okuyucu için en yararlı sınırı sağlar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السلة والإسلال بمعنى السرقة الخفية وما قاربها من أخذ الشيء من البيت على وجه السرقة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد النزع المباح ولا الخروج من الزحام ولا المرض
branches.source_phrase_ar: السلة والإسلال السرقة (maqayis)؛ الإسلال السرقة الخفية (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الإسلال الرشوة والسرقة (sihah)؛ سل الشيء من البيت على سبيل السرقة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çocuk ve hayvan yavrusunu, ayrıca bir kökten çekilip alınan öz ya da üreme maddesini aynı çıkış ilişkisi altında toplar. Dal kullanılabilir, ancak bütün öğelerin doğrudan soy anlamına gelmediği açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ortaklık, bir kökenden çıkmış olma ilişkisidir; kişi soyu ile maddi öz birbirine eşitlenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım türemiş adların kökenden çıkma ortaklığını verir; yavru ve maddi öz kullanımlarını ayrı alt alanlar olarak korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kökenden çıkan çocuk ya da yavruyu veya bir ana maddeden çekilip ayrılan özü anlatır; ortak çekirdek, kökenden ayrılarak meydana gelmedir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın kendi kökeninden çıkması veya ondan türemesi temel ilişkidir.
İnsan çocuğu ile erkek ve dişi at yavrusu, canlı kökenden çıkan varlıklar olarak adlandırılır.
Bir şeyden çekilip alınan öz ve insanın üreme maddesi aynı köken ilişkisine dayalı maddi kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik kaynak anlatımı, çocuk ve yavru ile kök maddeden ayrılan öz arasında kökenden çıkma bağı kurar; canlı soy ve maddi öz kapsamları ayrı tutulur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Canlı soy ile bir ana maddeden ayrılmış özü ortak köken ilişkisi altında birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kökenden çıkma ilişkisini, yavru alanını ve maddi öz alanını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın doğrudan çocuğunun kökenden çıkışı vurgulandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı kökenden doğan insan yavrusu ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Hayvan yavrusunu ve bir maddeden ayrılan öz kullanımını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Erkek ya da dişi at yavrusunun adlandırıldığı hayvan bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: At yavrusunun canlı kökeninden çıkması ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsan çocuğunu ve maddi öz kullanımını kapsam dışı bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir ana maddeden çekilip alınan öz veya üreme maddesi anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kökenden ayrılarak çıkan maddi özü korur.
error_profile.loses: Çocuk ve hayvan yavrusu anlamlarını kapsam dışı bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Canlı yavrunun yanında bir ana maddeden ayrılan özü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Soyun kuşaklar boyunca sürmesi ve üreme amacıyla yetiştirilen hayvanları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir canlıdan doğan çocuk veya yavruyu ve soy ilişkisini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kökenden çekilip çıkmış tek yavruyu ve maddi özü öne çıkarır; komşu dal soyun çoğalması ve kuşaklar boyunca sürmesiyle daha geniştir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; çocuk ve soy alanındaki yakın komşu, maddi öz uzantısını görünür kıldığı için seçildi.
